calculation.description: Ranks assets by three-day reversal relative to the cross-asset median, normalized by asset volatility, with a smooth positive activation when cross-asset dispersion is above its 60-day median. All inputs are lagged completed daily observations in online use.

validation.regime_notes: Positive one-day IC across reported slices: 2020 0.052399, 2023 0.045401, 2025 0.078325, and 2026-07 onward 0.043499. Five- and ten-day predictive strength decays, so admission uses the one-day horizon. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
validation.provenance: Executed scripts/miner_2_20270225_dispersion_norm_residual.py on 2027-02-25; signal artifact contains 72,840 asset-date rows.
